title: Negative regression test for old bug (sse_state_json_top_level_message_is_none) is correct design
description: The inverted regression test asserts that top-level get(Message) returns None — if the bug reappears (server starts putting Message at root level, or parse code is rolled back), the test fails rather than silently passing. A contributor might suggest removing it as 'redundant' — it is not redundant; it is a canary for the exact failure mode that was fixed. The comment explaining the inversion is present and correct.
